shared_elements: quadruped animal shown in profile, low relief
horizontal register band running across the upper part of the surface
row of repeated small motifs forming a band
small carved discs/round elements in the field
justification: Both surfaces show quadrupeds in strict profile carved in low relief beneath a horizontal band of repeated small motifs running across the top, which is the only notable correspondence. Otherwise the content is quite different: A is a crowded narrative scene with human figures, a wheeled chariot, harnessed horses and rosettes, rendered with modelled naturalistic musculature, while B shows isolated, flat, schematic animal silhouettes (a snouted quadruped, birds, a plant-like sign) stacked in separate registers with no interaction and no human or man-made objects.
